description: Original generated imagery for an explicitly unofficial Zara-inspired concept. These are not official Zara products, photography, or prices. Optimized WebP derivatives of the generated PNGs.

images.prompt: Use case: photorealistic-natural. Asset type: wide hero campaign photograph for an explicitly unofficial Zara-inspired clothing demo. Create an elegant high-fashion editorial photograph, landscape 3:2 composition. Two adult fashion models, a Black woman with short natural hair wearing a flowing chocolate-brown long-sleeve maxi dress, and a man with dark hair wearing a sand-colored relaxed overshirt and wide black trousers. Full body or almost full body, standing slightly apart in a sunlit minimal Mediterranean courtyard, textured warm ivory plaster wall, soft stone floor, late afternoon shadows. Sophisticated quiet luxury, realistic cloth folds, high-end analogue film texture, subdued colors, no saturation. Models on the right two-thirds, open textured wall on the left third for separate website text. Art direction feels like a contemporary European fashion editorial. No text, no logos, no watermark, no jewelry branding.
